comment: The demo Carnet's trip (« Mode voyage ») and records, shared by the iPhone and Android apps (2026-10-23). Same shapes as GET /v1/notebook/page (trip) and /v1/notebook/records, dated from today: start_in (days), a booking's day (1 = the first day), {date+N} (« 14 novembre »), {day+N}/{day-N} (an ISO day), next_in (days to a record's next date). The trip page joins the demo's subjects (kind trip).
